questions.en: What will come in place of ‘?’ in the following equation, if ‘ +’ and ‘ -‘ are interchanged and ‘x’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged? 12 ÷ 4 + 9 x 3 - 8 = ?

questions.trick: चिह्नों को बदलकर BODMAS का प्रयोग करें।
